title: 0xos decisions.json — the corrections feed
description: Replaces the unread markdown decision queue. Mostly non-blocking 'assumption' records the agent shipped and you review-after; only 'bounded' and 'needs-input' records ever pause an agent. The Decision Inbox renders this. Resolving an item writes back here and the agent drafts a DR.

kind.description: assumption = shipped on a default, review-after (non-blocking). bounded = hit a mechanical cap (pauses). needs-input = needs a fact only the human has (pauses).

summary.description: assumption: one line of what the agent did

assumed.description: assumption: the choice it made + why

shipped.description: assumption: spec id already built & merged

bound.description: bounded: which mechanical bound was hit

blocks.description: spec ids paused by this; empty = nothing blocked

body_ref.description: path to the long context/runbook (behind a fold in the UI)

resolution.description: on resolve: what the human chose

dr.description: on resolve: the DR id the agent drafted
